rows.n: Ya Kun Kaya Toast (Far East Square)
rows.w: Founded 1944; the flagship still grills wafer-thin charcoal kaya toast, SG's kopitiam icon.
In Keong Saik since 1939; one of the very few still doing old-school thrice-toasted kaya toast.
